name: Nhea Mestio
bio: I have 12 years of Dubai real estate experience in administration, human resources, optimizing business processes, and operational efficiency. Graduated Bachelor of Science in Nursing from my home country, Our Lady of Fatima University, Manila Philippines. From then I came to Dubai and started my career at one of the leading Dubai Real Estate companies taking the position as an administration manager. Later joined Knight Frank Middle East as one of the project marketing team, focusing on the Atlantis The Royal Residences project. Now, taking the position as an Operations Manager in Luxury Residences, who looks after the day-to-day activities of the business to ensure that it runs smoothly, and efficiently.

name: Sabeeha Bham
bio: I am a South African native, who began my career in private banking. Now based in Dubai, a real estate agent specializing in super prime residential real estate, with a particular focus on sea-facing branded residences. Driven by an appreciation for the world’s best 5* hotels as well as the phases of development from inception to fruition. Was part of the original developer sales team for the iconic Atlantis the Royal Residences. Now holds the title of the #1 resale agent for The W Residences, Palm Jumeirah. A trusted advisor to the top 1% globally. Operates on the premise of building long-term relationships, authenticity, loyalty, and honesty. I strongly believe that doing what you love means never working a day in your life. I am passionate about people, design, making a difference, strategy, and winning i.e. the art of deal-making.

name: Shaye Uekermann
bio: Having lived in Dubai for 13 years, Shaye offers not just an exemplary passion for people and a credible work ethic but exceptional knowledge and insight into both the Dubai property market and Dubai life overall. Specializing in the Palm Jumeirah, Shaye started her career selling beautiful apartments on the Palm Jumeirah trunk before moving on to the luxury villas that are nestled along the world-famous Fronds. She has spent years nurturing her client relationships, which has resulted in an invaluable personal network of repeat clients and referrals, while her client-centric ethos ensures that Shaye always strives to offer her clients a tailored, transparent experience that will leave them feeling confident in their property purchases.

name: Daria Egorshina
bio: Daria believes that building lifelong connections is the true measure of success. Every client relationship is based on trust, respect, and the understanding that buying or selling a home is deeply personal. Ambitious and detail-oriented, I strive to create meaningful, long-lasting partnerships with every person I work with. Her primary area of focus is Dubai’s waterfront communities—vibrant neighbourhoods that offer the perfect blend of modern city living and relaxed, luxurious seaside lifestyle.

name: Matthew Cooke
bio: Over the previous 17 years of becoming a seasoned real estate professional with internationally acclaimed brands such as Connells Group, Barratt Developments Plc, Knight Frank and Atlantis, The Royal Residences, I have gained invaluable experience into the diverse realm of residential property. Additionally, having now operated successfully within multiple international markets such as London and Dubai, I have evolved and created Luxury Residences which I believe to be the future business model for the international prime and super prime real estate agency. Based on traditional business values and ethics but incorporating revolutionary marketing strategies, assets and technology all the while having access to devoted unsurpassable Private Client Advisors and their valuable insights, we look forward to being your Agent of choice.
